signals._about: SIG-1: per-net driver edge, with the source of the number; `pcb signals` computes knee (0.5/t_rise) and bucket. Rails are judged by irdrop/currents, not knee. Assumptions are marked; replace them with measured edges when a scope is on the board.

SW.source: assumption: the TPS54620 datasheet gives no SW edge rate (min on-time 94 ns is the nearest number); monolithic 6 A sync bucks measure 2-5 ns on SW, 3 ns taken
SW.note: the aggressor the stackup policy is built around; In1 is its return

buck.BOOT.driver: U1.13 BOOT, rides on SW through C1 100 nF
buck.BOOT.source: same edge as SW (the bootstrap cap ties the node to SW)

PWM.driver: MCU GPIO on J3 -> U2.1 EN/IN1
PWM.source: assumption: MCU GPIO behind the control header, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns; no series R on the board or the cable
PWM.note: U2.1 has only the internal 100 k pull-down; a 100 R + 100 pF RC at the header would make it 22 ns (bucket 2)

DIR.driver: MCU GPIO on J3 -> U2.2 PH/IN2
DIR.source: assumption: MCU GPIO behind the control header, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns; no series R on the board or the cable
DIR.note: toggles rarely; the bucket follows the edge, not the rate

nSLEEP.driver: MCU GPIO on J3 -> U2.3 nSLEEP
nSLEEP.source: assumption: MCU GPIO behind the control header, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns; no series R on the board or the cable
nSLEEP.note: toggles rarely; the bucket follows the edge, not the rate

connectors.ENC_A_J.source: assumption: push-pull 3.3 V CMOS encoder output, 10 ns (the brief names no encoder); an open-collector hall encoder would be 100 ns-1 us (bucket 1-2)

ENC_A.source: R7 1k into the header-side load (~20 pF ribbon + MCU input): 2.2 RC = 44 ns, root-sum-square with the 10 ns source edge

MOTOR_A.source: DRV8874 datasheet tRISE/tFALL 150 ns (OUTx 10-90 %, VM 24 V)
MOTOR_A.note: 2 A edges: the magnetic aggressor for the sense nets (victim spacing), not a fast one

MOTOR_B.source: DRV8874 datasheet tRISE/tFALL 150 ns (OUTx 10-90 %, VM 24 V)

nFAULT.source: assumption: no nFAULT edge spec in the DRV8874 datasheet; open-drain pull-down into ~20 pF taken as 20 ns; the rise is R9 x ~20 pF ~ 0.4 us

LED_FLT_A.driver: nFAULT through the fault LED D1 (cathode on nFAULT); R1 470 from 3V3
LED_FLT_A.source: follows nFAULT's fall through the LED (series part)

IPROPI.driver: U2.6 IPROPI current mirror into R10 2.74k
IPROPI.source: the mirror follows the bridge current, which steps at the OUTx edge (tRISE 150 ns); weak aggressor (IIPROPI <= 3 mA)
IPROPI.note: analog, 2.74k source impedance, ~1.2 V/A; noise here is current-regulation error

ISENSE.note: ADC line to the header; high impedance

buck.FB.driver: 5V through the feedback divider R5 52.3k / R4 10k (DC)
buck.FB.note: error-amplifier input, ~8 k source impedance; noise here is duty-cycle noise

buck.COMP.source: compensation node, bandwidth about the crossover (tens of kHz)

buck.RT.note: high-impedance node; pickup here is frequency jitter

buck.SS.driver: U1.9 SS into C10 10 nF (slow ramp)
buck.SS.note: mild victim: matters at start-up only

driver.CPH.driver: U2.13 CPH charge-pump switch into C11 22 nF
driver.CPH.source: no edge spec; slew bound by I/C: tens of mA into 22 nF over ~5 V is >= 2 us; fVCP 400 kHz (datasheet)

driver.CPL.driver: U2.14 CPL charge-pump switch into C11 22 nF

driver.VCP.driver: U2.12 VCP charge-pump output into C13 100 nF (VM + ~5 V)

VIN_EXT.source: rail: judged by irdrop and currents
